en: The Dun Baldar North Bunker was destroyed by the Horde!
Give me the vessel, Highlord.
Ach! Thank you so much, $n! I'm free! Finally!

Their minds are now tainted, $r. Yes, even more so than before. They live only to serve and protect Razelikh. The amulet fragments they each hold are the key to summoning the demon lord. What you do not understand is that none of them can be harmed through any conventional means.
Certainly, $n. You only need to tell me what reputation you would like to know about.
A foul trogg if ever I saw one.  Die!
I thought I heard something.
That is tragic. How did this happen?
It is done, dragon. Lead the way.

I don't admit this lightly, but you are a far better smith than I am. If you want to learn more than my meager teachings then I suggest you seek out a Dwarf named Therum Deepforge in Stormwind. You will find him in the Dwarven District.

The journal of Jandice Barov is filled with rantings and ravings about the undead. Towards the end of the book is what appears to be a tailoring pattern for the creation of a bag of some sort. Your understanding of tailoring is insufficient to decipher the pattern.
Cheap beer!  Get your cheap beer right here!
Troggs?!  Are the troggs you mention the same as the ones in the world today?
I bet Josetta would be more than happy to teach you some new spells.  She is probably up in her room at the Lion's Pride Inn.
Hey Pratt - can you teach me how to make a Wild Leather Vest again?
What goods have I earned the right to purchase from the Defilers?
All of Nature's might is at my disposal, puny mortals. Let us see which of my many forms it will be that ends your suffering!
%s casually points at the orc target...
Join us, or fall forever!
No mysterious fossil here... Ah, but my copy of Green Hills of Stranglethorn.  What a good book!
What the... nobody cleanses a furbolg in MY camp!  Face the wrath of Xabraxxis!
Maybe you got it, maybe you don't. I think I got a way to find out...
Tomas may not be the best cook around, but he has a few dishes that hit the spot.  He's currently working in the Lion's Pride Inn if you'd like to learn the profession.
Thank you for freeing me, my sister, and all of you! We can finally rest in peace now.
Peace and patience be with you, $n. Remain strong always.
Miranda, could you please tell me the insignia cost of items that you are offering for adventurers of revered reputation?
%s begins tinkering with the goggles before the stone.
Alright, alright! I think I can figure out how to operate this thing...
Kel'Thuzad say to tell you... DIE!
The caverns below us are a source of strange and wondrous hides, but you must take care if you venture into their depths, $n. Remember that your own skin is far more valuable.
Have you heard the good news about Al'Akir, the Windlord?
Stormwind Counting House is located by the front gates in the trade district of Stormwind. And when you get tired of counting your money, be sure to stop by the Gilded Rose for a drink.
%s bows low before you.
You challenge the charge of the Blue Dragonflight? DIE, vermin.
You will not be disappointed, traveler. Tailoring is a joyous endeavor.
You know, this bridge is kind of large for just the 6 of us to be building. You'd think more people would've been hired.
